metadata.Author: Adam Seabridge
metadata.Readme:
Adds support for uploading WebP images to the Sitecore 10.4 Media Library.
Registers WebP as a media type with the correct MIME type and item templates. Includes custom image processing via SkiaSharp to read dimensions and generate thumbnails without any OS-level codec installation.
Files installed:
Config: App_Config/Include/Foundation/Sitecore.WebP.Upload/ Foundation.Sitecore.WebP.Upload.config
Binaries: bin/Foundation.Sitecore.WebP.Upload.dll bin/SkiaSharp.dll bin/x64/libSkiaSharp.dll
Items as Resources: sitecore modules/items/master/ items.master.Sitecore.WebP.Upload.dat
